name: Strong Hire: interviewer's spoken reply
description: The interviewer's next spoken line after a candidate answer: a follow-up (probe) or the next question (ask), from the scripted transcripts. The answer is streamed, so ttft is the time to the first spoken word (what the candidate waits for). word_limit uses the product's limit for the model's tier (35 words, 30 for small models). Prompts are Strong Hire's own (built by scripts/build_strong_hire.py); a model with prompt_tier small gets the small-model variant where the row has one.
